x: Sends best wishes to all and will be with us soon again. Pte. Joe Tranter (Splinter) writes from Malaya and by all accounts is doing quite well.
Joe (Splinter) Tranter sends greetings from Malaya and curses the powers that he was unable to be with us during the 1950 track season owing to extension of period of service.
Windley competed for us in the Long Jump, but could only finish 4th with a leap of 17ft. 10ins. J.
McLean and Joe Tranter could not get placed. We hope that Joe did not suffer too much when he crashed into, or should it be through, one of the hurdles.

Senior race we saw Len Bishop score a good win, with Joe Tranter second and a new member, Shackleford, in third position. The 2 miles walk handicap was won by Eric Hall, with George Oliver second and L.
